link.note: Named as mother in Thomas Heffernan's 1808 Gortnahoe baptism (Dwyer).

summary: John's 5th-great-grandmother; wife of Humphrey Heffernan of Lickfinn, Gortnahoe, Co. Tipperary.
bio: Anastasia Ryan married Humphrey Heffernan, miner of Lickfin, Gortnahoe parish (marriage record not found); the couple flourished 1805-1817 and baptized at least five sons at Gortnahoe.
sources: Michael Dwyer, Heffernans of Slieveardagh (Welsh Hill Press, 2020), Branch 4 (and Branch 3), working from the Killenaule and Gortnahoe Catholic parish registers: https://archive.org/details/heffernans-of-slieveardagh
